name: Recursive Teaching Dimension of Repeated-Coordinate Cubes
proof: Every target of the initial class has ordinary minimum teaching size n, by Section \ref{val:subset_teaching_dimension_repeated_coordinate_cube}. Any recursive teaching order must therefore pay n at its first removal. Conversely every remaining subclass is taught using one fixed coordinate per underlying bit, a sample of size n. Hence RTD is exactly n.
references: Local definition-driven proof; bounded independent replay in sync/verify_noclashing_antichain_gap.py.
